data.definition: A = |sum z| / sqrt(N * sum |z|^2), phi = arg(sum z), over the deck-edge mask pixels
data.delta_definition: delta = wrap(circmean(state) - circmean(RS)) over the state's dates; the states are consecutive and disjoint, so there is no per-date pairing between them, and because the circular mean is not linear this is not the difference of the series' own state phases; ci_lo/ci_hi are a seeded percentile bootstrap (20000 resamples, seed 12345)
data.dphi_definition: dphi = wrap(phi_bridge - phi_control), paired over identical overpass times, over the deck-edge mask pixels
